LITERAL_FRAME_DESCRIPTION: Near-white whiteboard; stick presenter at left holds paper; gray Earth centered on board; small gray question text at top.
Same board; outward black arrows now ring Earth.
Flat red full frame; black reclining figure/logo above large white 'what if?' and smaller 'THE VIDEO SERIES'.
Whiteboard returns; presenter left; circular Earth cross-section on board with triangular interior and radiating arrows.
Same board; center drawing becomes a black cave-like opening with gray rock edges and a small red 'what if?' badge.
Near-white ground line; one stick person centered; top black strip reads T = 1 SECOND.
Door at left, small plants, person, dog, and broad tree on ground line; T = 1 DAY strip.
Four labeled landmarks across white field: Cadillac Mountain, Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa; duplicated baseline and 864 m marker appear below.
Bent stick person stands on scale; black '70kg' becomes red '70.01 kg'; T = 1 DAY strip.
Black city/road silhouette spans lower third; small arch, trees, streetlamps; a white central building/window.
Stick presenter at left faces large gray Earth at right; dark curved/diagonal line crosses globe.
Thin bridge/ground line; dark-haired seated figure at left and standing stick figure at right; vertical supports below.
Small gray Earth at left-center; concentric circumference arcs and labels C, r; formula grows at right.
Earth diagram and formula 'C ~40,000 km + 2π · 864m = 5.4km'; red underlined 0.01%; black mini silhouettes ring globe later.
White car in black desert/road silhouette, cacti and plants; 'LOS ANGELES' label appears overhead.
Two satellites top corners link by dotted paths to a central radio/observation tower; red concentric waves pulse around tower.
Small desk with digital and analog clock at left, tall grandfather clock center-right, stick observer right; red '+3 SECONDS' arc and question mark appear.
Half gray Earth split by vertical black axis; labels accumulate: RADIUS +0.4%, GRAVITY +0.4%, MASS +1.2%; T = 1 MONTH.
Two circle/mass diagrams with vertical arrows; equation Fg ~ r and a small parenthetical formula note.
Three-panel stick-person scale examples: November 70.28 kg, December 71.14 kg; then Singapore 70 kg, New York 70.19 kg, Helsinki 70.35 kg.
Large hand-drawn stone aqueduct fills frame; many arches and rubble at both bottom corners; T = 1 YEAR.
Two-story house, tree, thin ground line and stairs; ground/house progressively sag and split into misaligned pieces.
Black city silhouette with slanted utility poles; curved gray Earth/sky plane rises above it; a small aircraft appears late.
Desk and grandfather-clock setup repeats; red '5 DAYS' callout beside clock; T = 5 YEARS.
Split-axis Earth with text GRAVITY: +25%; T = 5 YEARS.
Bent stick person on scale; '70kg' and red '88kg'; small black sentence overhead.
Aqueduct arches collapse left-to-right into piled blocks; red arrows indicate lateral movement.
Black skyline with very tall central Eiffel-like tower; red vertical arrow over tower; later white curved streaks cross sky.
Split-axis Earth labeled GRAVITY: +50%; hand-drawn circular turbulence/atmosphere grows around its left side.
Black lower landscape with clouds; arrows radiate from central AIR PRESSURE label; white pressure arrows and red + AIR PRESSURE label build.
Split-axis Earth enlarged at right; text GRAVITY: +300%; T = 40 YEARS.
Tall guillotine-like frame at left and tiny bent person at right with red 210kg label; T = 40 YEARS.
Huge cropped half-Earth at right beside standing stick person; a second person lies on ground; labels 1G and 6G appear at top.
White chart: CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM TOXICITY and oxygen-breathing-hours axis; gray graded bands with labels including pulmonary effects and no toxicity.
Large outlined pressurized dome spans frame; bed and prone person inside left; seated helmeted figure at right holds tray/cup.
Small analog clock at left points to tiny dot at right; top labels RADIUS INCREASES / DENSITY = CONSTANT and DENSITY INCREASES.
Presenter at left beside whiteboard; board compares small labeled EARTH clock graphic with large EXPANDED EARTH clock graphic; red labels later identify WHITE DWARF and further stellar terms.
Whiteboard comparison continues; large clock-like expanded Earth changes to a radial starburst, then a small marked disk; red labels update.
Black space field; grayscale Earth lower-left/center, small Moon upper-right, two or three white satellites, faint circular orbital paths; T = 300 YEARS.

Same space field; satellites circulate around Earth; a close small body enters/changes position; orbit rings thicken; final state shows stick figure at left observing a bright flattened ringed Earth-like disk.
Flat red end card: black reclining logo at upper-left; four book covers along lower center; small white book and credit text arranged at right.
